overlays.sourceOrganization: Ministry of Home Affairs (MOHA LIFe) — Sainthamaruthu-labelled rows only; corroborated by Ministry of Public Administration Ampara DS list
overlays.evidence: DCS English for 5225 is Sainthamaruthu. MOHA LIFe segment 5-2-25 mixes Sainthamarathu and Kalmunai North Sub Office labels (raw TRANSLATION_CONFLICT). PubAd Ampara list names Saindamarudu and Kalmunai North as separate DS units. Overlay uses the single agreed Sinhala/Tamil pair from MOHA rows whose DS English is spelling-compatible with Sainthamaruthu (Sainthamarathu), excluding Kalmunai North Sub Office rows. Not majority vote; not first-row selection across the mixed segment.
overlays.reviewNote: Phase 3.8. DCS English remains Sainthamaruthu. Raw MOHA conflict retained in join reports. GN children under 5225 already exact-join for Si/Ta.

overlays.sourceOrganization: Ministry of Home Affairs (MOHA LIFe) — Kalmunai North Sub Office-labelled rows; corroborated by Ministry of Public Administration Ampara DS list
overlays.evidence: DCS lists Kalmunai North Sub as DS 5221 (no MOHA HierarchicalDsCode 5221). PubAd Ampara list includes Kalmunai North as a distinct DS from Saindamarudu. MOHA publishes Sinhala/Tamil for 'Kalmunai North Sub Office' on LIFe 5-2-25 rows that are not Sainthamaruthu-labelled. Overlay applies those official DS-label names to DCS 5221. DCS English remains Kalmunai North Sub (Office is MOHA wording).
overlays.reviewNote: Phase 3.8. DS-level overlay only. GN mappings for 5221* not confirmed: MOHA Kalmunai-labelled GNs use LIFe codes 5225150+ which do not match DCS 5221*; English similarity alone is insufficient.

overlays.sourceOrganization: Ministry of Home Affairs (MOHA LIFe) — HierarchicalDsCode 3136 Hikkaduwa rows
overlays.evidence: DCS and MOHA both use DS code 3136 for Hikkaduwa with exact English name. After the 2019 Cabinet-approved split of the former Hikkaduwa area into Hikkaduwa/Ratgama/Madampagama, all 27 current DCS GN codes under 3136 fail LIFe exact-join (GN components renumbered), so matched-row DS aggregation yields no Si/Ta. MOHA still publishes a single agreed trilingual DS label on all 27 LIFe 3-1-36-* rows: Sinhala හික්කඩුව / Tamil ஹிக்கடுவை / English Hikkaduwa. Overlay reuses those official DS-label names for the same DCS code. GN children remain unresolved pending Gazette GN code lists.
overlays.reviewNote: Phase 3.8. Same-code DS identity (not a MOHA to DCS recode mapping). DCS English remains Hikkaduwa. Does not approve GN mappings from English similarity alone.
